quote: Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, announced Wednesday a multi-year agreement with Petrobras to extend the deployment of the Blue Marlin and Blue Orca stimulation vessels, supporting optimization of offshore oil and gas production in Brazil’s post and pre-salt fields. The award, which followed an open tender, also includes the provision of associated chemicals and services.
note: Opened Baker Hughes investor English primary 17 Sep 2025; CapEx/contract USD not disclosed.
